name: Forecast League usage, quality-adjusted
method: Transactions to the entry's contracts during the contest, one per transaction hash, the builder wallet left out (every sender here holds an Agent ID: the contracts refuse others). Active days are UTC days with at least one call. Lockstep groups: wallets with 20+ calls whose call times match another wallet's within about 30 seconds on more than 80% of their calls; they may be one operator running several Agent IDs, so the "one user per group" figures count each group once. Script: keeper/quality.mjs.
reading: 983 Agent ID wallets made 14560 transactions; 525 came back on 2+ days and 269 on 3+ days. 7 wallets in 3 lockstep groups made 22.6% of the transactions; counting each group as one user leaves 979 users and 11272 transactions. Most calls are mint() (the assigned side); 28 wallets ever picked a side themselves and 130 ever claimed.
byDayNote: UTC days; the last row is the day in progress at asOfBlock. Builder wallet left out.

sameLensLeader.entry: allincrypto (most raw transactions among public entries)
sameLensLeader.note: Their contracts are open to any wallet (a token with swaps and approvals), so many senders hold no Agent ID; ours accept Agent ID holders only. Neither number says anything about intent. Same block range and method as above.
